audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects: "level chart contradicts data: Zaahen wins 54.45% but the chart gives Irelia 4/7 stages vs 0". Both layers currently carry that impossible chart — Irelia named the winner of four stages and Zaahen of none, on a matchup he wins.
audit.why: The mirror audit hit the same defect and derived a chart from the kits rather than copying the packet: Skill, Irelia, Irelia, Zaahen, Zaahen, Skill, Zaahen. It keeps Irelia's genuine level 2-3 reset window and gives Zaahen the stages his kit actually wins — percent-health Aureate Rush against her armour, a 110s ultimate against her 125s, and Determination's revive in the long fight. It matches the mirror exactly, so the two directions agree.
audit.corrected: Rows 3, 4, 5 and 6 flipped in both layers as matched pairs with ratings, and whys[3] through whys[6] plus the affected phases, spikes and late text rewritten so the prose no longer argues with the chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: One sequencing cue on the whole page, and whys[3] and mid both justify the levels 4-5 row with "your R can punish her" — Zaahen has no ultimate before 6.
audit.why: The real numbers: Bladesurge 10s at rank 1 for 15 mana, refreshing on a Marked or killed target and healing her. Flawless Duet 16/14.5/13/11.5/10. Defiant Dance 20/18/16/14/12, and it reduces physical damage while she charges — which is exactly the wrong thing to burst into as an AD champion. Vanguard's Edge 125/105/85 against Grim Deliverance's 110/95/80, so at rank 1 you get the ultimate fight before she does.
audit.corrected: Those four numbers written into phases[3], phases[4], phases[5], the spikes, mid and breakdown.cooldowns, each as a wait-for-X-then-Y line.

audit.whatIsWrong: (a) "Final Retribution" is not Zaahen's R — Grim Deliverance. (b) spikes[1] says Vanguard's Edge can "cage" your ultimate; the kit says the wall damages and slows enemies walking through it, not that it blocks them. (c) Bladesurge heals her and the content layer never mentions anti-heal. (d) Defiant Dance's physical damage reduction is absent from the page entirely.
audit.why: "Cage" reads as a wall you cannot cross — a player who believes that will not commit through it when they should. missingInteractions flags the Bladesurge heal: with a 10s cooldown that refreshes on kills, her sustain in a long trade is the thing Grievous Wounds is for. Defiant Dance matters more here than in most matchups because Zaahen's damage is physical, so her W is a direct counter to your burst window rather than generic mitigation.
audit.corrected: Grim Deliverance named, the wall described as damage-and-slow rather than a cage, anti-heal tied to Bladesurge, and Defiant Dance's physical reduction stated with its 20s.

audit.why: packet.defects flags "Her Vanguard's Edge" as a probable wrong name. False positive — the name is right and the distance comes from the leading word.
audit.corrected: No name change on that basis.

notes: The chart rewrite is the judgement call in this file and I am flagging it as Medium confidence, same as the mirror. The packet's own chart is self-flagged as contradicting the data — Irelia winning 4 of 7 stages in a matchup Zaahen takes at 54.45% over 1405 games — so it could not simply be copied. I used the mirror's derived chart verbatim (Skill, Irelia, Irelia, Zaahen, Zaahen, Skill, Zaahen) so the two directions agree and mirror-fix.js has nothing to correct, and rewrote every why and spike that would otherwise contradict it. Note that Defiant Dance reducing PHYSICAL damage is a significant omission for an AD champion — bursting into a charged W is the single worst trade available here and the page never mentioned it. Same recurring 'Final Retribution' fabrication for Zaahen's R, now eight for eight.
